title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Credit Memo Schedule: Utilization Share on Line Reviews
content:
**Clause.** At a credit line review of a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the utilization share is 0.4 when the line-review utilization is above 0.5, 0.7 when it is above 0.3 but not above 0.5, and 1.0 when it is 0.3 or less. The line-review increase percentage is multiplied by the utilization share before it is applied to the current credit line.

**Line-review utilization.** The line-review utilization is the line-review measured balance less the amount under open billing dispute on the account (the disputed amounts of the account's dispute filings less the disputed amounts of its dispute resolutions and withdrawals), divided by the current credit line.

**Line-review measured balance.** The line-review measured balance is the account's current balance, except that for an account whose latest statement shows a promotional balance above zero and which has at least three statements dated fewer than three full calendar months before today it is the average of the statement balances of those statements, rounded half up to the cent, and for any other account with at least three such statements whose payments credited fewer than three full calendar months before today, less the payments returned unpaid in that span, total at least the statement balances of those statements it is the latest statement balance.

## Schedule

| Line-review utilization | Utilization share |
|---|---|
| above 0.5 (above 50 percent) | 0.4 |
| above 0.3 and not above 0.5 | 0.7 |
| 0.3 (30 percent) or less | 1.0 |

Boundaries: exactly 0.5 gives 0.7, and 0.5004 gives 0.4; exactly 0.3 gives 1.0, and 0.3004 gives 0.7.

## Measured balance by case

| Latest statement shows a promotional balance above zero | Statements dated fewer than three full calendar months before today | Payments in that span, less payments returned unpaid in it, against those statements' balances | Measured balance |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | at least three | any | the average of those statements' balances, rounded half up to the cent |
| no | at least three | at least their total | the latest statement balance |
| no | at least three | below their total | the current balance |
| either | fewer than three | any | the current balance |

## Worked case (hypothetical account: current balance USD 1400.00, credit line USD 3000.00)

Three statements in the span: USD 900.00, USD 1100.00 and USD 1250.00 (the latest), totalling USD 3250.00; no promotional balance; payments in the span USD 3500.00, of which USD 400.00 was returned unpaid, leaving USD 3100.00. That is below USD 3250.00, so the measured balance is the current balance, USD 1400.00. With USD 200.00 under open billing dispute, the utilization is USD 1200.00 divided by USD 3000.00, that is 0.4, and the utilization share is 0.7. Had no payment been returned, the measured balance would be USD 1250.00 and the utilization 0.35, still 0.7.

Had the latest statement shown a promotional balance, the measured balance would be USD 3250.00 divided by 3, that is 1083.333, rounded half up to USD 1083.33.
